mapper.select: SELECT r.id,r.name,r.gb_code,COUNT(d.tree_id) AS tree_count, count(d.tree_id) FILTER (where d.grade = 1) AS grade1, count(d.tree_id) FILTER (where d.grade = 2) AS grade2, count(d.tree_id) FILTER (where d.grade = 3) AS grade3, count(d.tree_id) FILTER (where d.grade = 4) AS grade4, count(d.tree_id) FILTER (where d.grade = 5) AS grade5, ST_ASGEOJSON(r.geom) AS geojson, ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_Multi(st_boundary(r.geom))) AS boundary from admin_region r left join diseased_trees d on ST_Within(d.geom,r.geom) WHERE r.level = 'province' group by r.id, r.name, r.gb_code, r.geom order by r.id

select c.name,c.gb_code, count(d.tree_id) AS tree_count, COUNT(d.tree_id) FILTER (WHERE d.grade = 1) AS grade1, COUNT(d.tree_id) FILTER (WHERE d.grade = 2) AS grade2, COUNT(d.tree_id) FILTER (WHERE d.grade = 3) AS grade3, COUNT(d.tree_id) FILTER (WHERE d.grade = 4) AS grade4, COUNT(d.tree_id) FILTER (WHERE d.grade = 5) AS grade5, ST_AsGeoJSON(c.geom) AS geojson, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Multi(ST_Boundary(c.geom))) AS boundary FROM city c LEFT JOIN diseased_trees d on ST_Within(d.geom,c.geom) where left(c.gb_code,5) = left(#{provinceGbCode},5) GROUP BY c.gb_code,c.name, c.gb_code, c.geom order by c.gb_code
